item.title: Big win for Celtic
item.description: Martin O'Neill has picked up a big a win on his return to the Celtic management team. Liam Scales picked up an assist as the Hoops beat Dundee United 4-0 in the Scottish Premiership. That result sees Celtic join Rangers in second place and just 3 points off leaders Hearts. item.title: Kerry people reminded to never click on suspicious links in texts or emails
item.description: People in Kerry are being reminded to never click on suspicious links or engage with suspicious messages from unknown numbers. Regional Chief Superintendent for the Southern Garda Region, Colm O’Sullivan says 2025 saw a spike in online and phone scams across the country. Some people in Kerry have been defrauded of tens-of-thousands of euro last year, with a number of individuals having their life savings cleared. item.title: Over 2500 new cars registered in Kerry in 2025
item.description: Over two and a half thousand new cars were registered in Kerry in 2025, that’s according to figures released from The Society of the Irish Motor Industry (SIMI). In total 2,588 cars were registered, an increase of 3% from 2024, representing 2% of the national share. Sixty-nine percent of cars registered in The Kingdom in 2025 were automatic, an increase of 11% from 2024, according to the SIMI. item.title: Club hurling final victory for Kilbrittain
item.description: Kilbrittain of Cork are the All Ireland junior club hurling champions for 2026. They edged out 2023 runners up Easkey by 19 points to 18 at Croke Park this afternoon. The Sligo side lost Andrew Kilcullen to a controversial red card in the second half. Advertisement That'll followed by the Intermediate final from quarter-past-5, which pits Mayo club Tooreen against Tipperary's Upperchurch-Drombane.

item.title: Gardaí and emergency services at scene of serious road incident on Tralee to Killarney road
item.description: Gardaí and emergency services are at the scene of a serious road incident on the main Tralee to Killarney road. It's believed that two vehicles are involved in the incident. The road at Brennan's Glen is blocked and will remain closed overnight. Advertisement Traffic from Killarney to Tralee is being diverted at Lawlor's Cross, while traffic from Tralee is being diverted at Ballyhar. Motorists are being advised to avoid the area if possible.
